name: Yashwant Das
subtitle: QA Architect • AI-Assisted Test Systems
heroSummary: Quality Engineering leader with 12+ years of experience building scalable automation systems across OTT streaming, e-commerce, fintech, and enterprise platforms. Currently focused on AI-assisted QA workflows, autonomous testing concepts, and maintainability-first automation architecture.
about:
I specialize in Quality Engineering, automation architecture, and AI-assisted testing systems with experience across OTT streaming, e-commerce, fintech, and enterprise platforms. Over the past 12+ years, I’ve led automation initiatives for Fortune 500 clients, built scalable UI/API/mobile automation frameworks, and driven quality strategy across web, mobile, cloud, and media ecosystems.

My current focus is exploring LLM-assisted QA systems, autonomous test workflows, multimodal validation approaches, and maintainability-focused automation engineering.

highlights: Led Quality Engineering initiatives across web, mobile, and API platforms with hands-on Playwright automation and release validation.
Drove shift-left testing practices by integrating early automation and quality validation into sprint workflows.
Collaborated with engineering and DevOps teams to embed automated quality checks into CI/CD pipelines.
Led automation architecture initiatives across web, mobile, API, and OTT platforms for Fortune 500 clients.
Built scalable automation tooling and Media QC workflows for OTT streaming validation and playback diagnostics.
Mentored QA teams and modernized automation approaches to improve resiliency, maintainability, and delivery efficiency.
Led Quality Engineering for high-traffic mobile and backend platforms across Android and iOS ecosystems.
Designed cross-platform automation frameworks using Appium and Cucumber integrated into CI/CD workflows.
Managed distributed QA collaboration across multiple LATAM regions supporting large-scale retail platforms.
Led OTT and VOD quality engineering across Smart TVs, Xbox, Fire TV, and mobile platforms.
Validated DRM compliance, streaming protocols, playback quality, and regional content availability.
Integrated automation, analytics, and monitoring workflows to improve streaming diagnostics and release confidence.
Automated Android platform validation using CTS frameworks to ensure device stability and OS compliance.
Led DRM compliance and media playback validation for Samsung Media Services and Media Hub.
Developed automation workflows improving test coverage and defect detection for mobile platforms.

projects.title: Autonomous Test Repair System
projects.description: LLM-assisted self-healing automation system for Playwright that detects failures, understands UI context from screenshots, and repairs flaky tests using deterministic heuristics and explainable reasoning workflows.

projects.title: Smart Playwright Protocol
projects.description: Agentic Playwright automation framework enabling structured QA workflows, MCP-oriented orchestration, and collaborative human–AI automation systems.
